entities.summary: Pastora Soler (b. 1978-09-28, Coria del Río) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Coria del Río and Spain. Known in the fields of spain, composers & musicians, europe.
